Live website | Active development

Diopong Primary School

The problem

Families and learners need an accessible place to find school information and supplementary learning resources in English and Sepedi.

My contribution

I built the responsive public website and bilingual learning hub, connected grade, subject and topic filters, and added quizzes, downloadable learning packs and browser-generated achievement certificates.

Technologies and approach

HTML, CSS and JavaScript; GitHub Pages hosting with GitHub Actions deployment. Worksheet and certificate generation runs in the browser without learner accounts.

What it delivers

The live site offers 160 bilingual activities, 20 per grade from Grade R to 7, PDF and editable Word worksheets, separate answers, and quiz certificates for Grades 4-7 at a score of at least 70%.

Current status

The website is live and maintained as it develops. School-approved information is being added as supplied. Learning content and Sepedi translations await teacher review; the staff dashboard is deferred.
